name: Saint-Joseph

limits: For red wine, Syrah: at least 90%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
Indication Géographique Protégée, the tier below AOC. It replaced vin de pays in 2009.
France's simplest category, in use since 2010. It replaced vin de table.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

notes: Northern Rhône reds are often known by their aromas of green olive and smoky bacon.
Syrah here is classically elegant, tannic and smoky, with restrained fruit.

blurb.text: A northern Rhône appellation. It covers the most land of the northern Rhône, though Crozes-Hermitage has more vines.
